finding.text: The diff.patch holds only code and docs; the generated `asks.jsonl` files, `doc/refined-asks.md` pages, `asks-by-module.md`, the card and the landing line are not in it, so I could not check the counts or the card title ("Refined asks: N recorded, M crossed off, K sent…").

Server/AskIndex.mjs:20 writes `doc/refined-asks.md` where the brief said `<module>/doc/asks.md`. ext/Refine/doc/asks.md explains why (four modules already have a hand-merged `asks.md`), so I accept the change, but the owner should know the name differs.

The brief says a "landing line whose title matches" also counts as done. `done_by` (AskIndex.mjs ~l.130) only uses AskTally's judged features. The doc says AskTally's status already comes from landings, so this is a small gap; it also admits only 19 of 1061 backfilled asks are done, so most routed asks will be inboxed even if they landed.

Server/RefineQueue.mjs:171 is only reached when `p.session` is set, and `after_refine` runs outside any try/catch. An inbox or fs error would fail an otherwise-finished refine run after its card was already added. Wrapping it and logging the error would be safer.

`AskIndex.test.mjs` covers record, done, inbox-once and no duplicates on re-run, and fits the "no duplicate lines on a re-run" ask. It uses a throwaway repo, not the real `ux/Dictate` with today's asks the brief named, so that step cannot be confirmed from the diff.
